title: Not Perfect
subtitle: Why “All or Nothing” is a Trap
bodyHtml:
Hey human.

Ever feel like if you can’t do something perfectly, it’s not worth doing at all?

Here’s the truth: perfectionism lies to you.
It says, “If it’s not 100%, it’s worthless.”

We say: "Don't let perfect stand in the way of good enough."

I don’t always catch the red dot.
Sometimes I jump and land sideways.
And guess what? I’m still a great cat.

Cats don’t do “all or nothing.”
We do some. We do a little bit. We do enough.

Nuance makes life a lot softer.
Us cats, we don’t chase perfection
— we chase naps, snacks, and comfort.

Don't be afraid to spill some coffee.
